items.result: The first production API prepare-check rejected integer-valued JSON triangle indices because JSON.parse_string represented them as floats. The runtime parser and its JSON round-trip test were corrected afterward.

The initial native Polygon2D capture produced blank cells: bone paths had been authored relative to Polygon2D while Godot resolves Polygon2D bone-weight paths from Skeleton2D. This attempt is retained as failed evidence.
The source-sprite baseline has 64/480 failing joint samples, all at zoom 3.4 across both facings.
The round-44 source overlap candidate still has 46/480 failing samples and remains rejected.

warning: Historical failure outputs are retained to show the debugging sequence; they are not acceptance evidence.
